$comment: D5's denylist for resident.interest — GEN-029-ST. NOT a contract file: the interest has no endpoint (ADR-011 D10), so this is not in packages/api-contracts and scans the SCHEMA column names + seed values, not a response corpus. Derived by diffing the THREE existing lists (resident-mobile, management-web, resident-portal), API-027-ST's method, with every decision recorded in `diffDecisions`.
purpose: ADR-011 D5 made mechanical: the interest carries party, unit, kind, effective range, provenance and audit — and NOTHING ELSE. A column or seed value named for money or an instrument is a defect, because the money is exactly what PEMO does not hold (D1).
theInversion: This runs OPPOSITE to API-027-ST's booking inversion. Booking moved {price, cost, tariff, fee} OUT of its denylist (into allowedExceptions) because rate cards are resident-facing by design. The interest moves the whole money/instrument family IN, because D1: PEMO holds the relationship, never the instrument.

money.reason: Any monetary amount or charge. D1: if a fact would change when the money changes, it is not PEMO's.

instrument.reason: The lease/title instrument and its clauses. PEMO records that a party holds an interest; the deed, the lease and their terms are outside (ADR-011 'what this ADR deliberately does not model').

secrets.reason: Universal, kept verbatim from all three lists. No credential in any row.

allowedExceptions.why: Provenance: how PEMO learned the fact (human_entry|bulk_import|external_reconciliation). D6.
external_reference is a PROVENANCE pointer — the external system's id for this fact — NOT a lease reference. Distinct from the forbidden 'leasereference'.
PEMO's own entity name; interest.unit_id is the whole point of D4. Same exception the three lists carry.

DELIBERATELY NOT FORBIDDEN — the mirror of booking's ADD. resident-portal forbade 'company'/'employer' as HKSTP residential residue; a resident.party of kind legal_person IS a company (D3's 'Company' label), and Novatek Ltd is a legitimate display_name. Forbidding it would make the legal-person case unrepresentable.

keptVerbatim: secrets — universal across all three; an interest row must carry no credential
invertedIn: money and instrument families — the D1 inversion, opposite to API-027-ST's {price,cost,tariff,fee} allowance for booking rate cards
dropped: deviceIdentity, telemetry, protocol, alarmLifecycle, mappingIdentifiers, correlationTrace, rawPayload — IoT/device/message-transport concerns; an interest is (party x unit x kind) with no device surface, so these cannot appear as an interest column or a seed value
carParkOperations — the car park is a Location/Unit concern, not an interest
bookingParty (heldby, bookedby, holdername) — booking-specific; no booking concept on an interest
crossTenant (otherorganization) — cross-org isolation is structural (organization_id scoping), not a column-name risk here
modified: hkstpResidue: booking ADDED company/employer/department as forbidden residential residue; the interest DROPS company/companyname/employer as forbidden and lists 'company' as an allowedException instead — a legal_person party is a company by design (D3). The mirror-image decision, recorded because it is the one a reviewer would expect to be inherited and must not be.
